svg.title: Swap the executor
svg.desc: The newest course of a stone wall, built to a taut red line. Three stones were set by three different hands: a gloved hand lifts its trowel off the first, the mechanical arm rises off the second with its claw open, and a pair of stone tongs on a chain opens off the third. All three meet the line the same way and carry the same bench mark, and a plumb bob hangs over the gap where the next stone goes.
